g.text: Qwen3-8B · existing answer rows fitted by ridge regression · internal weights fixed

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #19343a

g.text: A positive paired signal does not guarantee well-calibrated answers on new families.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64777d

g.text: 95% intervals: 5,000 paired bootstrap resamples. Familiar templates: 64 whole prompts. New families: 8 whole families, 128 prompts.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64777d

g.text: Family estimates weight families equally. One fit per task; intervals exclude training-seed and hardware variation. These are output-row fits, not SFT.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64777d

g.text: Next-token counts use the actual highest-probability token over the full vocabulary; counts are descriptive, without intervals.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64777d
